exposure: keeping mother and newborn together following cesarean birth
outcome: length of time mother and newborn stayed together
length of time to initiation of breastfeeding
cohort: Term, stable newborns born by cesarean birth.
finding: Standardizing care following cesarean birth to include keeping mothers and newborns together increased the length of time they stayed together, decreased the time to breastfeeding initiation, and increased the initiation of skin-to-skin contact.
